title: MZ Problem with Upgrade equipment plugin by PeGe.Dev

posts.author: Psychoholic42
posts.body:
I'm working on a game where, instead of buying weapons, your allies will be able to upgrade the ones they have, which are locked. The problem with the Upgrade Equipment plugin by PeGe.Dev is, when I level a weapon up, it says 'undefined', like in this screenshot.
I want it to keep the name of the weapon and add the +1, or whatever level it's on.
I'd also like the parameters to only show attack power and magic, since those are the only ones I want to use for the weapons.

posts.author: PeGe
